description: This PHP source file handles importing test cases from Mantis XML issues into the TestLink test management system. It includes functions for parsing XML, importing test cases, handling uploads, and initializing GUI components.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP object used for GUI and argument data structures.

methods.name: importIssueFromXML
methods.description: Imports test cases from an XML file into the database, returning a result map.

methods.name: saveImportedTCData
methods.description: Saves imported test case data into the database, handling duplicates and updates.

methods.name: importTestCasesFromIssueSimpleXML
methods.description: Extracts test case data from a simple XML object and saves it.

methods.name: getTestCaseSetFromIssueSimpleXMLObj
methods.description: Parses XML object to extract test case set information.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes GUI parameters and paths for the import process.
